description: Population allele frequencies and loss-of-function constraint for TWIST1 in gnomAD v4
code:
import requests, json, pandas as pd, numpy as np
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
H={"User-Agent":"Mozilla/5.0 openscientist","Content-Type":"application/json","Accept":"application/json"}

q="""query{ gene(gene_symbol:"TWIST1", reference_genome:GRCh38){
 variants(dataset: gnomad_r4){ variant_id consequence hgvsc hgvsp lof flags
   exome{ ac an } genome{ ac an } }
}}"""
r=requests.post("https://gnomad.broadinstitute.org/api",data=json.dumps({"query":q}),headers=H,timeout=180).json()
v=pd.DataFrame(r["data"]["gene"]["variants"])
def tot(row,f):
    e=row.get("exome") or {}; g=row.get("genome") or {}
    return (e.get(f) or 0)+(g.get(f) or 0)
v["ac"]=v.apply(lambda r_: tot(r_,"ac"),axis=1); v["an"]=v.apply(lambda r_: tot(r_,"an"),axis=1)
v["af"]=v.ac/v.an.replace(0,np.nan)
print("gnomAD v4 TWIST1 variants:",len(v))
print(v.consequence.value_counts().head(12).to_string())
lof=v[v.consequence.isin(["stop_gained","frameshift_variant","splice_acceptor_variant","splice_donor_variant","start_lost"])]
print("\npLoF-consequence variants in gnomAD v4: n=%d, total allele count=%d"%(len(lof),lof.ac.sum()))
print(lof[["variant_id","consequence","hgvsp","lof","flags","ac","an","af"]].sort_values("ac",ascending=False).head(20).to_string(index=False))
hc=lof[lof.lof=="HC"]
print("\nHigh-confidence LoF: n=%d, AC sum=%d, max AF=%.2e"%(len(hc),hc.ac.sum(),hc.af.max() if len(hc) else np.nan))
mis=v[v.consequence=="missense_variant"]
print("\nmissense n=%d; cumulative missense AF=%.4f"%(len(mis),(mis.ac.sum()/mis.an.median())))

# constraint plot
c=dict(exp_lof=12.861,obs_lof=8,oe=0.622,lo=0.365,hi=1.122,pLI=0.0156)
fig,ax=plt.subplots(figsize=(7,2.6))
ax.errorbar([c["oe"]],[0],xerr=[[c["oe"]-c["lo"]],[c["hi"]-c["oe"]]],fmt="o",color="#c0392b",capsize=5,ms=9)
ax.axvline(1.0,ls="--",color="k",lw=1)
ax.axvspan(0,0.35,color="#7fc97f",alpha=.3)
ax.text(0.17,0.55,"constrained\n(LOEUF < 0.35)",ha="center",fontsize=8)
ax.text(1.02,0.55,"no detectable constraint",fontsize=8)
ax.set_yticks([]); ax.set_xlim(0,1.5); ax.set_xlabel("gnomAD v4 LoF observed/expected (90% CI)")
ax.set_title("TWIST1 is too small for gnomAD constraint to detect haploinsufficiency\n(obs 8 / exp 12.9 pLoF alleles, pLI = 0.016, LOEUF = 1.12)",fontsize=10)
plt.tight_layout(); plt.show()
